column1: # SQL columns of each table, as agreed with the maintainer (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-19).
# One line per column, in printed order. A header the extractor reads must match these
# labels, or the table is refused: a renamed or added column is a decision, not a guess.
# table: the table key. col: the SQL column. type:
#   text    printed text, kept as printed
#   amount  a printed amount, parsed exactly (Decimal); a dash is NULL
#   number  a printed count or quantity, parsed exactly
#   code    an identity (`016`, `92956`): kept as printed, leading zeros matter
#   group   the heading printed once above a group of rows (MAE operator); carried onto them
#   carry   text printed in its column on a group's first row only (MEF II `Ditta`); carried
#           down to the rows under it, up to the group's `<name> Totale` subtotal, which must
#           name the same (maintainer, 2026-10-20: the table is a visualisation, not raw data)
#   years   the printed year columns of a table that prints a year window (T2): one
#           row per printed row and year, `anno` + `valore` (amount)
# labels: the printed header, `|` between the forms seen in different editions; a year is
#   written relative to the edition (`Y`, `Y-1`). Empty: the column prints no label.
# sum: `sum` when the column adds up to the table's printed totals and subtotals;
#   `sum else <col>@<col2>=<value>` when a blank cell counts as <col> on rows where
#   <col2> is <value> (MAE A1: an EUR authorisation leaves EURO blank, its value is
#   its Ammontare). `unless <col>`: a row where <col> is printed adds nothing (MAE A1:
#   a line with a customs value is not in the EURO subtotal; inferred from the subtotals,
#   and every one of the 159 matches it, to the cent or within conversion rounding).
